children.name:
Establish the first administrator exactly once, admit invited people,
      authenticate active humans, maintain revocable sessions, and let each
      person change only their own public profile and credentials.
terms:
"
      Establish the first administrator exactly once, admit invited people,
      authenticate active humans, maintain revocable sessions, and let each
      person change only their own public profile and credentials.
      "
"Every mutating request carries the acting or affected person identifier explicitly."
"Authorization can be checked at the application boundary without relying on ambient framework state."
"Do not let cookies, route parameters, or submitted ownership fields silently select another actor."
"Password verification, transfer tokens, and session tokens remain opaque boundary concerns."
"The domain needs authentication outcomes, never stored secrets."

"Never return passwords, password hashes, credential verifiers, session tokens, or automation keys from read models; invitation tokens leave the system only through administrator-only invitation views and administrator-authorized join links."

children.name: The first accepted account bootstrap, WorkspaceConfiguration and first active human administrator membership commit atomically. WorkspaceBootstrap is an internal owner handoff used only after accepting that first account; it is never an unauthenticated transport operation.
terms: "The first accepted account bootstrap, WorkspaceConfiguration and first active human administrator membership commit atomically. WorkspaceBootstrap is an internal owner handoff used only after accepting that first account; it is never an unauthenticated transport operation."

children.name: Workspace bootstrap succeeds at most once and the first human is an active administrator.
terms: "Workspace bootstrap succeeds at most once and the first human is an active administrator."

children.name: Only an unauthenticated caller holding a live individual invitation token may join. A successful join atomically creates the active human member and deletes exactly that token; all other tokens remain valid. A used or unknown code receives the same InvitationRejected failure without changing people or tokens.
terms: "Only an unauthenticated caller holding a live individual invitation token may join. A successful join atomically creates the active human member and deletes exactly that token; all other tokens remain valid. A used or unknown code receives the same InvitationRejected failure without changing people or tokens."

children.name: Email addresses are unique under canonical case-insensitive comparison among accounts that can authenticate.
terms: "Email addresses are unique under canonical case-insensitive comparison among accounts that can authenticate."

children.name: Only Active human principals may create interactive sessions; agent principals run through the agent-system boundary and automation principals authenticate through their integration boundary.
terms: "Only Active human principals may create interactive sessions; agent principals run through the agent-system boundary and automation principals authenticate through their integration boundary."

children.name: Opaque credentials are issued only by signIn or acceptTransfer; only their verifiers are persisted. verifySession derives the human principal from the credential, checks server time, current Active Human account, expiry, and revocation. Submitted person IDs, actor headers, connectivity and deployment-wide tokens are never human identity evidence.
terms: "Opaque credentials are issued only by signIn or acceptTransfer; only their verifiers are persisted. verifySession derives the human principal from the credential, checks server time, current Active Human account, expiry, and revocation. Submitted person IDs, actor headers, connectivity and deployment-wide tokens are never human identity evidence."

children.name: A session is accepted only while it exists, is unrevoked, unexpired, and belongs to an Active person.
terms: "A session is accepted only while it exists, is unrevoked, unexpired, and belongs to an Active person."

children.name: Signing out revokes only the presented session and disconnects that person's live connection associated with it.
terms: "Signing out revokes only the presented session and disconnects that person's live connection associated with it."

children.name: A transfer token is single-purpose, tamper-evident, time-limited, and cannot authenticate a Deactivated or Banned account.
terms: "A transfer token is single-purpose, tamper-evident, time-limited, and cannot authenticate a Deactivated or Banned account."

children.name: Profile editing never changes role, standing, principal kind, another person's profile, or any secret through submitted fields.
terms: "Profile editing never changes role, standing, principal kind, another person's profile, or any secret through submitted fields."

children.name: Deactivation and moderation require an active administrator who is not the affected person when that would remove the last active administrator.
terms: "Deactivation and moderation require an active administrator who is not the affected person when that would remove the last active administrator."

children.name: Deactivation revokes sessions and non-direct memberships and anonymizes reusable login identity while retaining authored conversation history and direct-thread continuity.
terms: "Deactivation revokes sessions and non-direct memberships and anonymizes reusable login identity while retaining authored conversation history and direct-thread continuity."

children.name: Banning revokes sessions, records the abusive network addresses known from those sessions, schedules removal of authored messages, and blocks unsafe requests from those addresses.
terms: "Banning revokes sessions, records the abusive network addresses known from those sessions, schedules removal of authored messages, and blocks unsafe requests from those addresses."

children.name: Unbanning removes the recorded network-address blocks and returns the person to Active without restoring deleted messages or prior sessions.
terms: "Unbanning removes the recorded network-address blocks and returns the person to Active without restoring deleted messages or prior sessions."

children.name: Avatar input is validated as an image and normalized by an adapter; generated initials, an agent glyph, or an automation glyph are presentation fallbacks, not stored domain identity.
terms: "Avatar input is validated as an image and normalized by an adapter; generated initials, an agent glyph, or an automation glyph are presentation fallbacks, not stored domain identity."

children.name: Authentication failure does not reveal whether the email, password, invitation, transfer token, or account standing caused rejection.
terms: "Authentication failure does not reveal whether the email, password, invitation, transfer token, or account standing caused rejection."
